TC-001-001.rule: exactly one labelled box; box centre within 0.15 of the image centre across and 0.2 down; box area 5-60 % of the image; brightness 70-190; sharpness at or above the split's median (568); one image per class drawn at random (seed 20261112)

TC-001-002.rule: 3 images per class of the pairs Motorcycle/Bicycle, Bicycle/Tricycle, Chairs/Bench; same filter as TC-001-001 without the centring condition; not reused

TC-001-003.rule: the 3 classes with the fewest instances in the test split (Doors 328, Trash Bins 401, Tricycle 493); 3 single-object clear images each, as TC-001-002

TC-002-001.rule: exactly one Person box and one box of a default-weight class (Animals, Doors, Chairs, Tables, Potholes, Trash Bins, Stairs, Bench) and nothing else; areas within 2x of each other, each at least 1 % of the image; brightness 70-190; Trash Bins images first (the tracker's example), then others at random, 3 in all

TC-002-002.rule: exactly two Person boxes and nothing else; the larger at least 3x the smaller's area; the smaller at least 1 % of the image; brightness 70-190; up to 3 at random

TC-002-003.rule: one single-object clear image per zone, box centre across at 0-0.15 (left), 0.45-0.55 (center), 0.85-1 (right); box area 2-30 %

TC-002-004.rule: one single-object clear image per band, box centre across inside the band with a 0.005 margin; box area 2-30 %

TC-002-005.rule: every image in the split with an empty label file

TC-003-001.rule: darkest: the 3 darkest images with at least one labelled object of at least 2 % area; moderate: 3 at random with mean grey 20-40 and the same object rule

TC-003-002.rule: anisotropy >= 3 (one gradient direction at least 3x the other), brightness 50-200, at least one object >= 2 %; of the 6 least sharp, the first 3 that look motion-blurred on inspection

TC-003-003.rule: the 3 images with the most labelled instances of a single class

TC-003-004.rule: 2-6 labelled objects, at least one pair overlapping by 30-80 % of the smaller box, both at least 2 % of the image; brightness 70-190; 3 at random
